_comment: Strategic risk factors derived from shockgraph.json and idea analysis. Each factor links to ideas exposed to it. Used for portfolio concentration analysis — two ideas sharing a factor are not independent bets.

riskFactors.name: EU Regulatory Timing Risk
riskFactors.description: Business depends on EU regulation being enacted, enforced, or interpreted as expected. Delays, softer enforcement, or political reversal would reduce urgency.
riskFactors.syntheticNote: Ideas sharing this factor look diversified by topic but may all weaken simultaneously if EU enforcement posture softens. Portfolio concentration across 20+ ideas.
riskFactors.portfolioImplication: HIGH_CONCENTRATION — a single macro shift (enforcement delay, political reversal) would weaken most of the EU compliance cluster simultaneously.

riskFactors.name: LLM API Cost & Availability Risk
riskFactors.description: Business depends on LLM APIs remaining available at current cost and capability level. Vendor lock-in, price changes, or capability commoditization could undermine moat or change cost structure.
examples: LLM capability built into competitor product for free
riskFactors.portfolioImplication: MEDIUM_CONCENTRATION — AI-native developer tools cluster. Monitor LLM commoditization.

riskFactors.name: SME Workflow Adoption Friction
riskFactors.description: Business depends on small and medium enterprises changing their compliance, reporting, or operational workflows. SME adoption is slow, budget-constrained, and often blocked by the absence of a dedicated IT buyer.
examples: owner does not trust AI-generated output for regulatory use
riskFactors.portfolioImplication: HIGH_CONCENTRATION — large SME compliance cluster. Shared adoption assumption: 'SMEs will pay €50–€150/month for a new compliance workflow tool.'

riskFactors.name: Enterprise Procurement Cycle Risk
riskFactors.description: Business depends on winning enterprise procurement. Long sales cycles (6–18 months), legal review, security audits, and procurement rules can delay or prevent revenue.
riskFactors.portfolioImplication: MEDIUM_CONCENTRATION — developer tools + regulatory handshake cluster. B2B enterprise sales may compete for the same limited sales bandwidth.

riskFactors.name: Open-Source / Free Alternative Risk
riskFactors.description: A key feature or primitive could be open-sourced or offered free by a well-funded competitor, collapsing the pricing power of the core product.
riskFactors.portfolioImplication: MEDIUM_CONCENTRATION — developer / research tooling cluster. Early moat depends on workflow lock-in before commoditization.

riskFactors.name: Third-Party Data Access Risk
riskFactors.description: Business depends on accessing data from a third-party source (registry, API, exchange, or public database) that could restrict or monetize access.
examples: EU registry API adds rate limits or paywalls
riskFactors.portfolioImplication: MEDIUM_CONCENTRATION — evidence/verification cluster. A single data access policy change could block several bets simultaneously.

riskFactors.name: EU/European Geography Concentration
riskFactors.description: Entire portfolio is optimized for EU market. A political shift in EU regulatory posture, a major economic downturn, or Brexit-style fragmentation would reduce total addressable market.
examples: EU regulatory reform reduces compliance burden
target country opts out of directive
riskFactors.portfolioImplication: HIGH_CONCENTRATION — virtually all regulatory ideas are EU-geography-specific. Diversification across geographies has near-zero representation.

riskFactors.name: Founder/Solo Time Availability Shock
riskFactors.description: All bets compete for the same limited founder time. A personal event, parallel obligation, or health issue could immediately degrade multiple simultaneous bets.
examples: health event reduces available hours by 50%
riskFactors.portfolioImplication: UNIVERSAL — affects every bet. WIP limits, reversibility preference, and reserve capacity are the primary mitigations. Cannot be diversified away without co-founder or team.

_meta.note: Exposure lists are representative, not exhaustive. Portfolios should re-assess when adding new bets.
